text: Deferred diagnostic export implementation prepared. An explicit checkpoint flag saves bounded raw midpoint states and scalar events during fitting; ordinary final admission/export stays within the unchanged one-hour deadline. Ten focused runner/loader/grid tests pass. Before panel expansion: replay OASIS 11→12 selected control with raw-only capture and require exact historical final-map equality; independently export original coarse-start and fine-start checkpoints and require byte equality for both maps, validity, warped images, metadata and export diagnostics/status. All original timeouts and cancellations remain terminal evidence.
